posts.title: What is infinity?
posts.abstract: How big are infinities? Why are some infinities bigger than others? Are there more real numbers than natural numbers? How can a plane and a line have the same number of points on them? We will look for answers to these questions and dive into the ocean of infinitely many different infinities.
